notes: De-duplicated heavily: many areas repeated the same idea (WebSocket auto-reconnect appeared in chat-streaming, data-integrity, running-sessions; queue-while-running appeared in chat-streaming + chat-composer + running-sessions; LCS/word-diff appeared in transcript-render + polish; persistent stream-json driver appeared 4x; settings persistence + configurable host appeared in polish + platform-meta + faces; light theme + semantic tokens appeared 3x; schema-version/migrations 3x; FTS column-drift repair 2x; image inline render 3x; archive 2x). Each merged idea is represented once and assigned to the layer/file that truly owns it. Selection favored high-impact/low-effort and foundational enablers. Scheduling: foundational modules first (settings store + AppSettings, multi-source schema + migrations, persistent stream-json driver/control-protocol, durable archive, GitService, config module) since permission-UI, git-UI and config-UI all depend on them. Within EACH wave every item owns a DISTINCT file/dir; heavily-contended web components (ChatPane, MessageView, DiffView, Markdown, SessionsPane, SearchPalette, DashboardPane, App, ui, lib/ws) appear at most once per wave with recurring work pushed later; new self-contained files maximize parallelism. ownsFiles lists the primary file each agent edits plus brand-new files it creates.
